Writing Functions I
================

## Functions!

Start small w Z scores

``` r
x_vec = rnorm(n=40, mean = 12, sd = 63)

(x_vec - mean(x_vec))/sd(x_vec)
```

    ##  [1] -1.38974020 -1.19007887  1.39771292 -1.41527075 -0.91142182 -0.73089654
    ##  [7] -0.09092787 -0.14333224  1.41064185  0.58321523 -0.27012604 -0.79304431
    ## [13] -0.57372507  0.73606013  0.77034596  1.06449888 -1.33809735  0.89536448
    ## [19]  0.98273236  1.18141460 -0.41210910  0.92627935  0.47753841  0.28178145
    ## [25] -0.90372466  0.57548814  0.12953817  0.83851930  0.27533346  0.63154031
    ## [31] -0.71174345  0.81152425 -0.30404374 -0.53094865  1.54160760 -1.64205655
    ## [37] -1.14621589  1.67655950 -0.42707882 -2.26311443

Let’s turn this into a function

``` r
z_scores = function(x) {
  
  if(!is.numeric(x)) {
    stop("input x must be numeric")
  } else if (length(x) < 5) {
    stop("x should have 5 or more numbers")
  }
  
  z = (x - mean(x))/sd(x)
  
  return(z)
  
}
```

Does this actually work??

``` r
z_scores(x_vec)
```

``` r
mean(x_vec)
```

``` r
sd(x_vec)
```

    ## [1] 55.86166

write a fxn that returns the mean and sd of an input vector.

``` r
source("source/mean_and_sd.R")
```

check that this works

``` r
mean_and_sd(x_vec)
```

    ##    mean    sd
    ##   <dbl> <dbl>

## Motive and write another one!!

``` r
sim_df = 
  tibble(
    x = rnorm(n=40, mean = 12, sd = 3)
  )

sim_df |> 
  summarize(
    mean = mean(x),
    sd = sd(x)
  )
```

    ## # A tibble: 1 × 2
    ##    mean    sd
    ##   <dbl> <dbl>
    ## 1  12.5  2.60

``` r
source("source/sim_mean_sd.R")
```

``` r
sim_mean_sd(n_obs = 40, mu = 12, sigma = 3)
```

    ## # A tibble: 1 × 2
    ##    mean    sd
    ##   <dbl> <dbl>
    ## 1  11.9  2.83

``` r
sim_mean_sd(50, 12, 3)
```

